words.ar: مؤشرات القياس / الأرقام اللي بنقيس بيها الأداء
words.def: numbers used to measure how well a business, team or process is performing.
words.book: Here are the key performance metrics for the last quarter.
uses: Please find attached the service metrics for Q3, including average response time.
which metrics does the client care about most? uptime?
Our key metric this year is first-time fix rate.
dont: These are the numbers of measuring the performance.
doo: These are our key performance metrics.

words.def: to show or point out that something is important.
words.book: This graph highlights the impact of the recent policy changes on our customer satisfaction rates.
uses: I'd like to highlight that the offer is valid until the end of the month.
can you highlight the discount in the quote? they missed it last time
This chart highlights how many failures were caused by old batteries.
dont: I want to put the light on this point.
doo: I'd like to highlight this point.

words.def: to become more popular, accepted or successful over time.
words.book: As I mentioned earlier, one approach that has gained traction is leveraging AI and machine learning to improve patient outcomes.
uses: Lithium-ion UPS systems are gaining traction in the Egyptian market.
solar for factories is really gaining traction this year 🔆
Remote monitoring has gained traction with our banking clients.
dont: Solar is taking a big spread now.

words.def: the act of putting a plan, system or decision into action.
words.book: As you can see, the data shows a significant increase in patient satisfaction levels following the implementation of our proposed solution.
uses: Implementation of the new monitoring system will start on 1 November.
who's handling the implementation at the Maadi site?
dont: After the applying of the system, the problems stopped.
doo: After the implementation of the system, the problems stopped.

words.def: to support what you say with facts, numbers or evidence.
words.book: In this presentation, the presenter will be using various techniques to grab the audience's attention, move seamlessly between ideas, and back up his points with numbers, research and common knowledge.
uses: The attached test report backs up our recommendation to replace the batteries.
do we have numbers to back that up? the client will ask
Let me back this up with data from last year's service calls.
dont: I will support my speaking with numbers.
doo: Let me back this up with numbers.

words.def: all the customers a company has.
words.book: Let me walk you through this chart, which shows the distribution of our customer base.
uses: Our customer base now includes over 60 hospitals and banks.
we need to grow our customer base in Upper Egypt
Most of our customer base is in the telecom sector.
dont: We have a big base of clients.
doo: We have a large customer base.

pro: These numbers paint a clear picture of the current situation.
upgrade.why: ‎paint a clear picture‎ تعبير قوي ومستخدم جداً في العروض.

upgrade.plain: Let me explain the chart for you.
pro: Let me walk you through this chart.
Let me explain you the chart.
I will explain on the chart.
upgrade.why: ‎walk you through‎ = يشرح خطوة بخطوة، ومتقولش ‎explain you‎.

upgrade.plain: The sales went up very much.
pro: The sales went up very much.
There has been a significant increase in sales.
upgrade.why: ‎a significant increase‎ أدق وأكثر مهنية من ‎very much‎.

upgrade.plain: For example, I will tell you a story.
pro: For example, I tell you story.
To put this in context, let me give you an example.
I will say you an example.
upgrade.why: ‎To put this in context‎ بتربط المثال بالنقطة اللي بتشرحها.

upgrade.plain: Studies say that batteries die faster in heat.
upgrade.ar: الدراسات بتقول البطاريات بتموت أسرع في الحر
pro: Research has shown that high temperatures shorten battery life.
Studies say batteries die fast in heat.
The research is saying heat kills batteries.
upgrade.why: ‎Research has shown that‎ بتدي كلامك مصداقية.

upgrade.plain: Everybody knows that the electricity cuts in summer.
upgrade.ar: كله عارف إن الكهربا بتقطع في الصيف
pro: All people know electricity is cut.
It's a well-known fact that power cuts increase in summer.
upgrade.why: ‎It's a well-known fact that‎ أرقى، و‎power cuts‎ مش ‎electricity cuts‎.
